_doc: Single source of truth for code coverage thresholds. See REPO-STANDARDS-SPEC [COVERAGE-THRESHOLDS-JSON]. NO GitHub repo variables. NO env vars. This file is read by the internal _coverage_check recipe inside make test. make test exits non-zero if measured < threshold. Thresholds ratchet UP only.

conformance._doc: Required pass percentage for the frozen python/typing fixture regression suite. POLICY: every fixture must pass the upstream revision's own unmodified calculator; any failure tanks the PR. python/typing@main has removed the Basilisk adapter, so conformance/run_conformance.py clones the last adapter revision (a4906624f170c169cf667f962080c56d5a5ba6ff) FRESH on every run, runs its src/main.py --only-run basilisk against the compiled default-config binary, and records the exact graded commit. This is internal regression evidence only: the former 100% conformance claim was retracted after AST-preserving mutations exposed test-specific behaviour, and Basilisk is not currently in python/typing's results. The raw threshold must not be published as Basilisk's conformance level. conformance/run_mutation_conformance.py and independent off-suite tests are separate mandatory integrity gates. There is NO vendored calculator or cached-fixtures fallback. DISABLING, DELETING, or UNREGISTERING a rule, hand-editing results, or loosening this gate to fake a pass is forbidden. See [CHKARCH-CONFORMANCE] and [CHKARCH-CONFORMANCE-MUTATION].
conformance._fp_ceiling_doc: Maximum total false-positive diagnostics across the frozen fixture set (diagnostics Basilisk reports on a line the suite does NOT mark # E, or outside a satisfied # E[tag] group). POLICY: zero — a single false positive tanks the internal regression gate. Enforced by conformance/run_conformance.py --gate, which runs the pinned upstream harness on the compiled binary and delegates the pass/FP check to conformance/assert_wheel_conformance.py (run by scripts/test-rust.sh inside make test). Ratchet DOWN only; now at the 0 target. This is not an official conformance metric. Close every gap by fixing the checker, never by disabling a rule.
